about: One short row per Awoken Skill; src/domain/xv2/awoken-sheet.ts expands each into a full catalog record. A row holds only what its wiki page says: a cost, drain or effect size the page doesn't give stays unknown. ki is the Ki needed to transform, in points (100 is one bar). effects are [stage, property, fraction, note]. grades are MODEL judgments (docs/ingest/catalog/GRADING.md). Turn Golden is hand-written in catalog.json and is not repeated here.

rows.name: Kaioken
rows.ki_note: 100 Ki for Kaioken, 300 for x3 Kaioken, 500 for x20 Kaioken: the more Ki you have when you transform, the higher the stage.
rows.description: The higher your Ki when you transform, the greater the power-up! But it'll also become a great burden, so watch out!
drain: 6% at Kaioken, 12% at x3, 46% at x20. The drains add up if you climb stage by stage (64% at x20) instead of transforming straight to x20.
rows.notes: The Parallel Quest must be cleared with an Ultimate Finish. Stamina drains the whole time you are transformed; when it runs out the transformation ends and your guard is broken. Stamina costs other than Evasives are discounted (fully at x20). Transforming has no knockback burst, unlike other Awoken skills.

burst_damage: +15% to all attack damage at x20 Kaioken (2.5% and 7.5% at the lower stages); 10-19% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: +15% to all attack damage at x20 Kaioken, basic attacks included; 10-19% is grade 3.
ki_economy: A cost you choose: 1, 3 or 5 bars for the three stages.
stamina_safety: Drains stamina the whole time, and breaks your guard when it runs out.
mobility: A buff to movement speed: +15% ground and +25% air and dash speed at x20.
survivability: Makes you take more damage: +30% at x20 Kaioken, +10% at x3.

rows.name: Potential Unleashed
rows.description: Unleash your latent abilities for a massive power-up! This mode can charge Ki quicker than other modes.

get.other: The final Patroller Academy advancement test, which opens once every earlier advancement test is cleared with a Z rank.

rows.notes: The wiki lists no downside and no drain. Despite the in-game description, the wiki says it does not change Ki restoration or give any Ki Auto-Recovery.

burst_damage: +15% to all attack damage; 10-19% is grade 3.
sustained_damage: +15% to all attack damage, basic attacks included; 10-19% is grade 3.
ki_economy: Needs 5 Ki bars to transform; 4 or more is grade 1.
mobility: A movement buff of about 10%: +11% ground and dash speed, +7% air speed.

rows.name: Beast
rows.ki_note: The 500 Ki is spent on transforming, not just required.
rows.description: Unleash the beast within and gain a massive power boost! While transformed, your attacks and Ki recovery are boosted! Use (H, L, H, H, H, H, H) to perform a special combo!
actions: Your race's H, L, H, H string becomes Beast's own seven-input combo.
The standing light attack and the charged heavy attack teleport, as in the Super Saiyan forms; charged Supers do not.

get.other: Reach maximum friendship with the mentors Gohan & Videl and Piccolo, tell Piccolo "I want to train even more", then clear the sparring mission against Cell Max.

rows.notes: The wiki says it gives no movement speed increase. The transformation takes unusually long, which leaves you open to charged heavy attacks while you transform.

burst_damage: +30% to all attack damage; 20-34% is grade 4.
sustained_damage: +30% to all attack damage, basic attacks included; 20-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Spends 5 Ki bars to transform, partly made up by +20% Ki restoration while transformed.
survivability: Makes you take more damage: +20% while transformed.

rows.name: Ultra Instinct
rows.ki_note: You need 500 Ki to transform, but since update 1.22.00 it is no longer spent.
rows.description: Unlock your true potential and awaken a power beyond that of a god! Consume Stamina to automatically dodge attacks! Use [JUMP input] after dodging to counterattack, and use [HEAVY attack input] while guarding to charge Ki. Your normal and charged Ki Blasts are improved as well!
actions: Dodges basic melee attacks and normal Ki Blasts automatically, for 100 stamina each.
After a dodge, a counterattack for 100 Ki that deals about 15% damage.
Holding heavy attack while guarding charges Ki (Surging Spirit), faster than Ultimate Charge.
A short hold fires Soaring Fist and a full charge fires Spirit Pulse.

get.other: Win a match against Jiren (Full Power), found beneath the steps to the Time Nest.

rows.notes: The wiki says it gives no change to attack damage, movement speed or damage taken. Each automatic dodge costs a stamina bar, so a run of dodges can break your guard. If you are attacked while transforming, the attacker is knocked away or countered, though a charged heavy attack can still break your guard.

burst_damage: No increase to attack damage, per the wiki.
ki_economy: Adds a Ki charge faster than Ultimate Charge without using a skill slot; it needs 5 bars to transform but does not spend them.
stamina_safety: Every automatic dodge costs a stamina bar, and a run of them can break your guard.
control: A counter: a counterattack after each automatic dodge.
survivability: Automatically dodges basic melee attacks and normal Ki Blasts while you have stamina; Supers and Ultimates still hit.

rows.name: Future Super Saiyan
rows.description: Can recover Ki (Energy) faster than any other type of Super Saiyan. Select again when transformed to undo the transformation.
actions: Light attacks, charged heavy attacks and fully charged Ki Blast skills teleport, as in every Super Saiyan form.

get.other: Clear the Future Gohan mission, which opens after the Bardock mission once you have 5 Time Distorted Eggs.

rows.notes: A single stage. Despite the description, the wiki says Ki regeneration is reduced, as in Super Saiyan, and that what it actually raises is stamina regeneration, by an amount it doesn't give. It gives no damage resistance. The transformation is notably quick. The owner has it; a Frieza Race character can't use it.

burst_damage: +5% to Ki Blast skills and +10% to Strike skills; graded on the smaller, under 10% is grade 2.
ki_economy: 3 bars to transform; Ki regeneration is also reduced while transformed.

rows.name: Super Saiyan God
rows.description: Channel godlike energy and gain strength that transcends mortal abilities! Your normal attacks are greatly boosted in this form!
rows.notes: The wish appears once friendship is at maximum with Goku, Vegeta, Gohan & Videl, Gotenks and Pan. It does not boost Strike or Ki Blast skills. The owner has it; a Frieza Race character can't use it.

burst_damage: Does not boost Strike or Ki Blast skills, per the wiki.
sustained_damage: +60% to basic attacks; 35% or more is grade 5.
ki_economy: +60% Ki recovery the whole time you are transformed, for 3 bars to transform.
mobility: A movement buff of about 10%: +13.5% speed.

rows.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
rows.description: Transform into a Super Saiyan shrouded in divine energy! This form gives you a massive-power up, but also gradually drains your Ki!
drain: The in-game description says it gradually drains Ki; the wiki gives the effect as a 10% decrease to Ki recovery.
actions: A step vanish on the light attack, and teleports on charged attacks and fully charged Ki skills.
rows.notes: Also called Super Saiyan Blue. Whis gives it to a character of level 90 or above with maximum friendship, whatever their race. It greatly reduces the Ki you gain from dealing and taking damage. The owner has it; a Frieza Race character can't use it.

sustained_damage: +25% to all damage, basic attacks included; 20-34% is grade 4.
ki_economy: Needs 5 Ki bars to transform, then lowers Ki recovery by 10% and cuts the Ki gained from fighting.

rows.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
rows.description: Surpass your limits to protect those close to you! You will become more powerful than SSGSS, but will also use much more Ki!
drain: The wiki says Ki drains gradually, much faster than in Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan, and gives the effect as an 18% decrease to Ki recovery.
actions: Charged attacks gain the same teleports as in any other Saiyan transformation.
rows.notes: Also called Super Saiyan Blue (Evolved). Whis gives it to a character of level 95 or above who already has Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan and maximum friendship with Vegeta, whatever their race. It greatly reduces the Ki you gain from dealing and taking damage. The owner has it; a Frieza Race character can't use it.

burst_damage: +35% to all damage; 35% or more is grade 5.
sustained_damage: +35% to all damage, basic attacks included; 35% or more is grade 5.
ki_economy: Needs 5 Ki bars to transform, then lowers Ki recovery by 18% and cuts the Ki gained from fighting.
